maria: Quick check — onboarding nova-lite-7B weights (safetensors, tp=2). Converted with our usual script but generation truncates on first newline and tokenizer outputs extra <unk>. Uploaded artifacts to s3://redwood-models/onboard/nova-lite-7b/v1/sha256-abc123. Can @devon @raj take a look at shard layout + tokenizer config? :thinking:

devon: Can you paste the conversion command + the small log tail? Also did you use fp16 or bf16 during convert? Those change rounding behaviour.

maria: Command: `python tools/convert_checkpoint.py --in ckpt/ --out out.safetensors --dtype fp16 --tp 2 --shard-layout default`
Log tail:
```
[INFO] quantize: false
[WARN] tokenizer mismatch: tokenizer.json.vocab_size (50265) != weights embedding (50272)
[ERROR] generation: token_id 50270 -> <unk> when decoding
```
Not huge log, error repeats on sample generations.

raj: tokenizer mismatch usually means added special tokens or uneven embedding sharding. If embedding matrix padding wasn't applied during shard split, you get extra rows in weights. Check `tokenizer.json` for `added_tokens` and also confirm embedding rows % TP == 0.
Suggested quick-check:
```
python tools/inspect_weights.py --weights out.safetensors --check-embed-size
# expects embedding_size % (tp * 1) == 0
```
If padding needed, run `scripts/shard_fix.py --pad-embeds 8 --in out.safetensors --out out.padded.safetensors`.

sasha: Also note: runtime currently expects fp16 for this model class. bf16 can be lossy on CPU->GPU conversions when kernels pick different paths. If you converted with bf16 try `--dtype fp16` and revalidate. For tokenization quirks, run the tokenizer offline against a small prompt set: `python tools/tokenizer_check.py --tokenizer tokenizer.json --examples samples.txt`

maria: Ran inspect_weights and found embedding rows = 50272, tokenizer.vocab_size = 50265 -> 7 extra rows. That explains the <unk>. The conversion script used default shard splitter which didn't pad embedding matrix. Will run shard_fix. Quick eval before fix: ppl 11.2 -> after fix expect similar but no <unk>. Sample before fix:
```
> prompt: "List three fruits:\n1."
> output: "1. apple\n2. bana\n\n"  # truncates and has weird tokenization around newline
```

devon: Yep that's consistent. Embedding must be padded to nearest multiple of tp * 8 in our runtime. After padding re-run `python tools/validate.py --weights out.padded.safetensors --smoke-gen`. If smoke passes, push to s3 path `.../v1/padded-1` and we can attempt a canary deploy. Ops-bot will auto-run smoke.

ops-bot: CI job 4812 triggered for canary smoke on /mnt/models/nova-lite-7b/v1/padded-1. Current status: FAILED. Log: `serve-smoke.py: AssertionError: sample contains <unk>`. (This is the previous artifact; awaiting new upload.)

maria: Starting pad+reconvert now with `scripts/shard_fix.py --pad-embeds 8 && python tools/convert_checkpoint.py --in ... --out out.padded.safetensors --dtype fp16 --tp 2`. Will re-upload to s3 and ping here when done. ETA ~1.5-2h. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

raj: quick note for posterity — we should update convert script to validate embed size and auto-pad when possible, or at least warn with explicit remediation steps. Filing a tiny follow-up PR after this is resolved.

maria: Great, thanks all. Will ping once smoke job picks up. :thumbsup:
